response.sql:
SELECT per_rental.store_id, AVG(per_rental.rental_total) AS avg_rental_total, AVG(per_rental.payment_count) AS avg_payments_per_rental
FROM (
  SELECT i.store_id, r.rental_id, SUM(p.amount) AS rental_total, COUNT(*) AS payment_count
  FROM payment p
  JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  WHERE p.amount >= 4.99
  GROUP BY i.store_id, r.rental_id
) AS per_rental
GROUP BY per_rental.store_id

assumptions.assumption: “Applying a 4.99 cutoff” means keeping payments with amount >= 4.99 before totaling and counting them.
